blocks.text: Nucleic acids nucleotide ikaiyon (units) ke polymers hain. In ki do bari qismein hain, deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) aur ribonucleic acid (RNA). DNA zyada tar chromosomes mein milta hai, thori miqdar mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein; RNA nucleolus, ribosomes aur cytosol mein milta hai. Nucleotide ek nucleoside aur phosphoric acid se bana hai, aur nucleoside ek nitrogen wale base aur ek pentose sugar se.

items: Pentose sugars: RNA mein pentose ke taur par ribose aur DNA mein deoxyribose hota hai.

Nitrogen wale bases: nucleic acids mein in ki do qismein hain, pyrimidine bases aur purine bases. Pyrimidine ek ring wala base hai; nucleic acids mein teen pyrimidine bases hain: cytosine (C) DNA aur RNA dono mein, thymine (T) sirf DNA mein, aur uracil (U) sirf RNA mein. Purine do rings wala base hai; DNA aur RNA dono mein do purine bases adenine (A) aur guanine (G) hain. Ek nitrogen wala base pentose sugar ke carbon 1 se jur kar nucleoside banata hai.

Phosphoric acid: nucleoside phosphoric acid ke saath ester linkage bana kar nucleotide ban jata hai; is ester linkage mein phosphoric acid pentose sugar ke C-5 se jura hai. Nucleic acids ka backbone sugars aur phosphates se bana hai.

blocks.text: Ek nucleotide mein phosphoric acid ka pentose sugar ke C-5 par ester linkage hota hai. Yehi phosphoric acid doosre nucleotide ke pentose sugar ke C-3 par ek aur ester linkage banata hai. Is tarah har phosphoric acid ke do pentose sugars ke saath do ester linkages hain, ek C-5 par aur doosra C-3 par; yeh do ester linkages phosphodiester linkage hain, jo do nucleotides ko jorti hai. RNA ke nucleotides ribonucleotides aur DNA ke deoxyribonucleotides hain; nucleotides ka naam un ke nitrogen wale base par rakha jata hai.

blocks.title: ATP aur NAD
blocks.text: Nucleotides cell ki zindagi mein doosre nihayat aham kirdar bhi ada karte hain. ATP adenine ka triphosphate nucleotide hai: ek ribose sugar se teen phosphate groups jure hain. ATP cell ki tawanai (energy) ki currency hai; yeh yake baad deegre do phosphate groups alag kar ke, ADP aur phir AMP mein badal kar, tawanai deta hai. Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) ek coenzyme hai jo cell ke oxidation-reduction reactions mein hydrogen lene wale (acceptor) ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar panels: ek nucleotide neele phosphate, pentose ring aur jamni base ke taur par jis par 5', 1' aur 3' carbons nishan-zada hain; paanch bases ek ring (cytosine, thymine, uracil) aur do rings (adenine, guanine) ke taur par; do nucleotides ek phosphate ke zariye ek sugar ke 3' carbon se agle ke 5' carbon tak jure; ATP adenine, ribose aur surkh high-energy bonds wale teen phosphates ke taur par, aur NAD apne phosphates se jure do nucleotides ke taur par, jo nicotinamide par khatam hota hai.
blocks.caption: Nucleotide, nitrogen wale bases, phosphodiester bond, ATP aur NAD (Figures 4.39 se 4.43 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Pentose ke carbon 1 se jura base nucleoside banata hai; carbon 5 par ester-jura phosphate use nucleotide banata hai. Pyrimidines ki ek ring hai: cytosine DNA aur RNA mein, thymine sirf DNA mein, uracil sirf RNA mein. Purines ki do rings hain: adenine aur guanine dono mein. Phosphodiester bond mein ek phosphate do ester links banata hai, ek sugar ke carbon 5 aur agle ke carbon 3 se, is liye polynucleotide zanjeer ka ek azaad 5' phosphate aur ek azaad 3' hydroxyl hota hai. ATP adenine, ribose aur teen phosphates hai aur phosphates kho kar ADP aur AMP ban kar tawanai deta hai; NAD dinucleotide coenzyme hai jo oxidation-reduction reactions mein hydrogen leta hai.

blocks.text: Nucleotides phosphodiester linkages se jur kar lambi polynucleotide zanjeerein banate hain. Polynucleotide zanjeer mein 5' sire ka phosphate group aur 3' sire ka OH group hamesha azaad hote hain. RNA ek polynucleotide zanjeer se bana hai; DNA do polynucleotide zanjeeron ka double helix hai.

Rosalind Franklin aur Maurice Wilkins ne DNA ki molecular banawat ka mutala kiya. James D. Watson aur Francis Crick ne 1953 mein DNA ka model pesh kiya; banawat maloom karne mein Chargaff ke mushahide (observations) bhi bunyadi ahmiyat ke the.

blocks.title: Watson aur Crick se pehle
blocks.text: 1950 mein Linus Pauling ne nateeja nikala ke DNA ek reshedar (fibrous) madda hai aur resha kundli (helix) mein lipta hai. 1951 mein Erwin Chargaff ne maloomati data diya jis se pata chala ke DNA mein adenine aur thymine barabar nisbat mein hain, aur guanine aur cytosine bhi.
Watson aur Crick ka DNA model darj-e-zail nuqte tajweez karta hai.

items: DNA do polynucleotide zanjeeron, ya strands, se bana hai.
Do strands ek doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banate hain.
Double helix ek seerhi (ladder) jaisa hai. Is ke khambe sugars aur phosphate groups se bane hain; is ke dande (rungs) nitrogen wale bases ke joron se.
Har base pair (danda) ek purine (A ya G) aur ek pyrimidine (C ya T) base se bana hai.
Do strands apne bases ke darmiyan kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure hain.

Ek zanjeer ka adenine doosri zanjeer ke thymine se hydrogen bonds banata hai, ya is ke bar-aks; ek zanjeer ka guanine doosri ke cytosine se, ya is ke bar-aks. A-T jore ke darmiyan do hydrogen bonds hain aur G-C jore ke darmiyan teen.
Do strands apni phosphodiester linkages ke lihaz se ek hi simt mein nahin chalte; yeh ek doosre ke antiparallel hain.

blocks.alt: Baen, khuli hui DNA seerhi: do sugar-phosphate khambe jin ke 5' aur 3' sire nishan-zada hain aur teer mukhalif simton mein chalte hain; base pairs ke dande, A aur T do nuqtedar hydrogen bonds se aur G aur C teen se jure. Daen, wohi do strands narangi aur neeli helix ke taur par ek doosre ke gird lipte, un ke darmiyan dande.
blocks.caption: Watson aur Crick ka double helix, khuli seerhi aur lipti shakal mein (Figure 4.44 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Seerhi ke khambe baari-baari sugars aur phosphates hain; dande base pairs hain, hamesha ek purine ek pyrimidine ke saath: adenine thymine ke saath do hydrogen bonds se aur guanine cytosine ke saath teen se. Do strands antiparallel hain, ek 5' se 3' aur doosra 3' se 5' chalta hai, aur ek doosre ke gird double helix mein lipte hain, Watson aur Crick (1953) ka model jo Franklin aur Wilkins ke X-ray mutalon, Pauling ke helix ke khayal aur Chargaff ki daryaft (A barabar T, G barabar C) par bana.

blocks.text: DNA chromosomes ka bunyadi hissa hai aur is liye eukaryotes mein nucleus ke andar hota hai. Prokaryotes mein alag nucleus na hone ki wajah se un ka DNA cytoplasm mein hota hai. Viruses mein DNA markazi molecule hai jo protein ke ghilaf se dhaka hai. DNA tamam jandaron (organisms) ka wirasati (hereditary) madda hai (kuch viruses ke ilawa). Is mein woh "program" hai jo aakhir kar tamam cellular sargarmiyon ki rehnumai karta hai, genes ki shakal mein. Gene DNA nucleotides ki woh tarteeb (sequence) hai jo ek polypeptide banane ka code rakhti hai. Jab gene "on" hota hai to DNA nucleotides ki tarteeb RNA mein transcribe aur phir khaas proteins mein translate hoti hai. Is tarah DNA cell ki khususiyat aur sargarmiyan qaboo karta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karen
blocks.text: Eukaryotes mein DNA ki thori miqdar (taqreeban 2 fisad) mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein bhi hoti hai. Bacterium E. coli ke chromosome mein DNA ke har strand mein taqreeban 50 lakh (5 million) bases ek khaas seedhi tarteeb mein hain, jin mein genes hain jin mein har ek kai sau bases ka hai.
RNA ribonucleotides se bana hai. Yeh transcription ke amal mein DNA ke deoxyribonucleotides ke samne ribonucleotides jor kar banta hai. Tamam zinda cells mein RNA ki teen qismein hoti hain.

items: Messenger RNA (mRNA) ribonucleotides ke ek strand par mushtamil hai jis ki nucleotides ki tarteeb DNA ke ek strand ki nucleotides ki tarteeb ki takmeeli (complementary) hai. Yeh cell ke kul RNA ka taqreeban 3 se 4 fisad hai. Yeh DNA ka genetic paigham ribosomes tak le jata hai taake khaas protein bane.

Transfer RNA (tRNA) nisbatan chhota hai, ek helical banawat jis ka molecule clover ke patte jaisa hai. Yeh kul RNA ka 10 se 15 fisad hai. tRNAs protein synthesis mein amino acids ko ribosome aur mRNA tak le jate hain.

Ribosomal RNA (rRNA) nucleoli ka DNA banata hai. Banne ke baad yeh ribosomal protein se jurta hai aur ribosomes bante hain. Yeh kul RNA ka taqreeban 80 fisad hai aur ribosomes mein protein synthesis ki machinery ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.text: Tamam jandar genes parhne aur zahir karne ka ek hi bunyadi tareeqa istemal karte hain, jise aksar central dogma kehte hain. Pehla qadam maloomat ka DNA se RNA ko muntaqil hona hai, jo tab hota hai jab gene ki RNA copy banti hai; yeh amal transcription hai. Doosra qadam maloomat ka RNA se protein ko muntaqil hona hai, jo tab hota hai jab RNA mein maujood maloomat protein banane ki rehnumai karti hai; yeh amal translation hai. Is tarah DNA cell ki khususiyat aur sargarmiyan qaboo karta hai.

blocks.alt: Upar: teen RNAs, mRNA ke liye bases wala seedha ek strand, tRNA ke liye clover ka patta, aur rRNA ke liye andar strands wala do-hisson ka ribosome. Neeche: teen boxes, DNA, RNA aur Protein, jo transcription aur translation ke teeron se jure hain.
blocks.caption: RNA ki teen qismein aur central dogma (Figures 4.45 aur 4.46 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Tamam RNA ek strand wala hai. mRNA DNA ke ek strand ki copy hai jo paigham ribosome tak le jata hai (cell ke RNA ka 3 se 4 fisad); tRNA chhota aur clover ke patte jaisa hai aur amino acids ribosome tak lata hai (10 se 15 fisad); rRNA nucleoli ka DNA banata hai aur protein ke saath ribosomes banata hai (taqreeban 80 fisad). Central dogma maloomat ka bahao hai, DNA se RNA transcription se aur RNA se protein translation se.

blocks.caption: DNA aur RNA ka muqabla
rows: Chromosomes (nucleus); kuch mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein; prokaryotes mein cytoplasm
Wirasati madda; genes polypeptides ka code rakhte hain
mRNA paigham le jata hai, tRNA amino acids lata hai, rRNA ribosomes banata hai

blocks.prompt: DNA ka ek strand 5'-ATGGCA-3' hai. Takmeeli strand us ke siron ke saath likhen, chhe joron mein hydrogen bonds ginen, aur woh do qadam batayen jin se yeh gene protein ban sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: Takmeeli strand: 3'-TACCGT-5' (antiparallel). A-T joron mein do hydrogen bonds aur G-C joron mein teen: A-T, T-A, G-C, G-C, C-G, A-T se 2 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2 = 15. Transcription gene ko RNA mein copy karti hai, aur translation RNA se protein banati hai.

items: Nucleic acids nucleotides ke polymers hain: pentose (RNA mein ribose, DNA mein deoxyribose), nitrogen wala base (ek ring wale pyrimidines C, T, U; do rings wale purines A, G) aur C-5 par ester-jura phosphate. Base aur sugar nucleoside hai.

Phosphodiester bond ek phosphate ke zariye ek sugar ke C-5 ko agle ke C-3 se jorta hai; zanjeeron ka azaad 5' phosphate aur 3' OH hota hai. ATP (adenine, ribose, teen phosphates) tawanai ki currency hai; NAD dinucleotide coenzyme hai jo hydrogen leta hai.

DNA (Watson aur Crick, 1953; Franklin, Wilkins, Pauling, Chargaff): double helix mein do antiparallel strands, sugar-phosphate khambe, purine-pyrimidine dande, A-T do aur G-C teen hydrogen bonds se. Gene polypeptide ka code hai; DNA kuch viruses ke ilawa wirasati madda hai.

RNA ek strand wala hai: mRNA (3 se 4 fisad, paigham le jata hai), tRNA (10 se 15 fisad, clover ka patta, amino acids lata hai), rRNA (80 fisad, ribosomes banata hai). Central dogma: DNA se RNA transcription se, RNA se protein translation se.
